findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:532-596 fail-open when required checks are omitted. For a registered production-gate-decision surface such as authority-receipt-ref, evaluateProofAdmissibility defaults checks to {} and only rejects required schema/shape/digest/signature/material/subject/producer validations when callers explicitly pass false or an unsupported string. A caller that omits checks entirely still matches the production-completion policy and reaches allowed=true plus productionDoneEligible=true at lines 595-596. This violates the fail-closed contract for proof-looking artifacts and is not covered by packages/main/src/tasks/proof-admissibility-smoke.ts, which only exercises the happy path with all valid checks present and unknown artifacts without a definition.

packages/main/src/core/proof-admissibility.ts:532: evaluateProofAdmissibility fails open when required checks are omitted. For authority-receipt-ref + DONE + production-completion, an empty checks object (or no checks) skips schema/shape/digest/signature/subject/producer/material requirements because the code only adds reasons when optional fields are explicitly false or mismatched. Repro: node --input-type=module -e "import { evaluateProofAdmissibility } from './packages/main/dist/core/proof-admissibility.js'; console.log(evaluateProofAdmissibility({artifactKind:'authority-receipt-ref',consumer:'DONE',claim:'production-completion'}))" returns allowed=true and productionDoneEligible=true with reasons=[]. This violates the plan admissibleProof conjunction and productionDone boundary: production-gate-decision should only be productionDone eligible after current schema, strict shape, semantic digest, signature/receipt, subject, producer, and temporal/material bindings are affirmatively valid. Add negative smoke coverage for missing checks and fail closed with missing_required_field/clause_not_bound (or equivalent structured reasons).
